title: Summit Purchased Miles Terms
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member may buy award miles.

1. **Amount.** Miles are bought in whole multiples of the purchase increment, and at least the smallest purchase, in one purchase.
2. **Price.** The former clause setting the price "at the price per 1000 miles for each thousand miles" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the price of a purchase.
3. **Membership status.** Miles are purchased only for a membership whose status is enrolled, active or dormant on the membership record.
4. **Annual limit.** The miles purchased in the calendar year, together with the new purchase, may not exceed the most miles a member may purchase in one calendar year. The calendar year runs from January 1 to December 31, US Central time, and the miles already purchased are the sum of the miles on the membership's purchase entries dated inside it.
5. **Nature of purchased miles.** Purchased miles are non-refundable, earn no qualifying dollars and count as qualifying activity.

| Membership status | Purchase possible |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Dormant | Yes |
| Closed | No |

**Hypothetical case.** With an annual limit of 150000 miles, a member who has bought 146000 miles since January 1 may buy 4000 more miles, bringing the year to exactly the limit, but not 5000.

superseded_clauses: at miles_purchase_price_per_1000_usd for each thousand miles
